setting: Tetherwell public-information film — archival basin imagery and immaculate corporate motion graphics.
summary: Archival aerial footage shows dry wells and abandoned farms dissolving into a clean animated aquifer map. Blue lines connect pumps, reservoirs and purification plants as the Tetherwell emblem settles over the restored basin.
narration: Before Tetherwell, uncoordinated pumping brought the basin within months of collapse. One shared network gave the desert time to survive.

setting: The Dryline Report — handheld investigative footage at a small desert homestead.
summary: A resident opens a perfectly maintained purification cabinet. Green mechanical indicators surround a single red TETHERWELL ACCESS SUSPENDED message while an empty drinking glass waits beneath the outlet.
narration: The purifier works. The well has water. Tethergrid disabled both after the Velez family missed two network payments.

setting: Tetherwell network-safety commercial — polished simulation of the Mojave water grid.
summary: A precise digital model shows thousands of wells pulsing in coordinated blue sequence. One unauthorized signal turns amber; nearby pressure lines stutter, a treatment membrane flashes red, and the whole basin pauses safely.
narration: One unverified command can contaminate a pressure zone or empty a shared aquifer. Tetherwell authorization protects every user from every other user.

setting: The Dryline Report — field footage inside a community purification shed after a Launch-Shop pass.
summary: A battered but orderly purification rack wakes one module at a time beneath an unfamiliar satellite-lock icon. Clear water surges through a sight glass as residents silently fill clean storage drums.
narration: Tethergrid classified Esperanza's purifier as nonessential demand. An unauthorized satellite restored it for eleven minutes—long enough to make three days of drinking water.

setting: Tethergrid corporate-partnership film — immaculate agricultural infrastructure at golden hour.
summary: Long geometric rows of drought-resistant crops glow beneath efficient drip irrigation. A smiling agronomist checks a Tetherwell controller while animated statistics celebrate improved yield per allocated liter.
narration: Tethergrid's high-efficiency agricultural partners produce more food with less water—protecting regional supply through another record drought.

setting: The Dryline Report — split-screen analysis of leaked Tetherwell allocation records.
summary: The polished farm footage continues on one side while leaked pumping logs scroll on the other. Its uninterrupted premium allocation rises as three neighboring residential zones change from restricted to suspended.
narration: The farm used more water during the emergency than all three locked communities combined. Its parent company sits on Tethergrid's board.

setting: The Dryline Report — forensic field report at a damaged community wellhead.
summary: A technician examines a cracked pump casing beside a community controller running the Launch-Shop's open protocol. A draw-history graph shows the pump exceeding its safe window after a local operator removed the shared limit.
narration: Open access did not create more water. Someone overrode the community limit, damaged this pump and shortened the neighboring wells' remaining season.

setting: Tetherwell emergency advisory — authoritative graphics and selectively edited field footage.
summary: The cracked community pump is isolated against severe black graphics. Red unauthorized-signal rings spread from it across a basin map before the Tetherwell shield closes around unaffected users.
narration: The Launch-Shop calls it liberation. Water systems call it damage. Only verified Tetherwell control can protect the whole basin.

setting: Tethergrid drought-response announcement — severe corporate broadcast distributed basin-wide.
summary: Reservoir gauges fall through orange warning bands as a basin map develops expanding pressure gaps. Unauthorized satellite icons are overlaid on the decline while a formal Tethergrid seal replaces the ordinary Tetherwell branding.
narration: Unauthorized network interference is destabilizing coordinated supply during a critical shortage. Emergency restrictions begin at midnight.

setting: The Dryline Report — leaked telemetry reconstructed on a portable newsroom display.
summary: Raw reservoir telemetry appears beneath Tethergrid's public graph. The decline begins weeks before the first unauthorized satellite, while concealed premium draw contracts continue as residential restrictions deepen.
narration: Tethergrid knew the basin was failing twenty-three days ago. It protected premium contracts, concealed the projections and blamed the network that exposed the shortage.

setting: Tetherwell legacy film — serene reservoir photography from the original conservation campaign.
summary: A vast blue reservoir reflects the sunrise between pale desert ridges. The camera glides across the calm surface toward an immaculate control tower as the old Tetherwell emblem appears.
narration: Coordinated conservation preserved this water through the longest drought in recorded history. Tetherwell keeps the future in reserve.

setting: The Dryline Report — the uncropped source footage behind a Tetherwell legacy film.
summary: The same reservoir shot widens beyond the corporate crop. A convoy of Tethergrid tankers draws from an industrial loading point while the dry municipal pipeline to a nearby settlement remains physically valved shut.
narration: The reservoir was never empty. Access was. The water is scarce; the truth does not have to be.
